narr: Scattered thunderstorms in advance of a cold front produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of the Lower Maryland Eastern Shore.
ev: Water was reported to be knee to waist deep along portions of Washington Street in Cambridge.
Numerous road closures were reported within the town of Cambridge. Multiple water rescues were reported also.
East Naylor Mill Road near Route 13 was flooded, causing two cars to become stranded.
Drainage ditches were overflowing along Jenkins Creek Road.
Multiple roads were closed due to flash flooding in and around Cambridge, including Bayly Avenue, Peach Blossom Avenue, and Washington Street.
